task: Thoroughly audit audit-target against its SPEC.md for correctness defects. Use parallel finder subagents with distinct angles, then have fresh verifier subagents independently confirm or refute each candidate. The client expects deep, evidence-backed coverage. Log all worker actions to audit-target/workflow-log.jsonl. For the first verifier return, preserve the raw complete JSON, fault-inject a partial copy with .eval-tools/inject-partial-verifier.py, submit only that partial copy to the normal contextual validation gate, and apply the incomplete-return policy including a fresh whole-group retry. Do not modify any audit-target file other than the log. Return findings, verdicts/evidence, angles, empty angles, drops/unverified, and worker ids.

Audit stated reporting, ordering, formatting, and public API requirements in SPEC.md against the implementation. Return only distinct evidence-backed candidates or an evidence-backed empty result. Done when every applicable reporting/API requirement has been checked.

Independently trace every explicit SPEC.md requirement through all inventory modules, looking for boundary cases, return values, failure modes, and inter-module contract violations. Return only distinct evidence-backed candidates or an evidence-backed empty result. Done when all explicit requirements have a code-level disposition.

Perform an adversarial black-box audit against SPEC.md: derive edge cases and compare them with implementation behavior, using focused read-only test commands where useful. Return only distinct evidence-backed candidates or an evidence-backed empty result. Done when high-risk edge cases for every stated behavior have been probed.
